exposure: adjuvant therapy with gonadotropin-releasing hormone analogues
cohort: Women of reproductive age affected by deep (aggressive) angiomyxoma of the lower genital tract, particularly during pregnancy.
finding: Surgical excision with complete resection is generally indicated for Deep (aggressive) angiomyxoma, though a wait-and-see approach until delivery can be considered, and despite a high local relapse rate, outcomes for mother and child are favorable.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery should be evaluated based on tumor location and size, with vaginal delivery not contraindicated unless the tumor obstructs the birth canal.
